clips.title: The story
paras: Gol'dir is free and carries news to Krusk in Tarren Mill. The Syndicate's leader, Aliden Perenolde, visited him and spoke of enslaving orcs who resist him. Perenolde also brought Elysa, a girl wearing the pendant the Warchief desires.

Gol'dir has news for Krusk after a visit from Aliden Perenolde, head of the Syndicate. Perenolde called himself lord of the land and said he meant to enslave the orcs who resist him. His father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned the same. Gol'dir sends you to carry this news to Krusk in Tarren Mill. He will follow after settling his own business where he is.
Perenolde also brought his mistress, a slight girl named Elysa. Around her neck hung the pendant the Warchief desires.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A day or two ago, I was visited by the leader of this Syndicate. His name was Aliden Perenolde, and styled himself lord of this land. He confided in me his plans to take the orcs that stood against him as slaves, just as his father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned.
More important was that he brought his mistress, a wisp of a girl named Elysa. Around her neck was the pendant the Warchief desires.
Now go, I will make my own way, after I have settled my business here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The nerve of those overbearing humans! We'll show them that the orcs shall never submit to their will!
This will now be our mission, in addition to recovering the trinket the Warchief desires. It would seem that by accomplishing one, we will also accomplish the other.
